literal_values.rationale: Three distinct exact-design GO receipts authorize writing one pure mathematical source file only; all import, compilation, test, wrapper, child, seed, and experiment actions remain locked.

authorization_decision_schema.review_receipts_rule: Exact array [theory,accounting,red_team] of three distinct retained receipt paths and SHA-256 values satisfying review_receipt_schema; reviewer_id values are pairwise distinct.

rules: role is exactly theory, accounting, or red_team and matches the retained path
reviewer_id is a nonempty ASCII identity and all three identities are distinct
design commit, tree, consistency, API, and amendment digests equal the reviewed immutable design
findings_sha256 is SHA-256 of canonical ASCII JSON array of the review's findings strings; GO uses an empty array

source_authorization_amendment.scope_replacement: This V6 singleton pure-core transition supersedes the five-path V5 source-writing proposal. V5 campaign-wrapper design is preserved as review_required and receives no authority.
source_constraints: Only the singleton authorized path may be created or modified.
Source text must conform exactly to pure-core-api-v6.md.
Writing does not authorize importing, parsing through Python, compiling, testing, executing, or auditing the source.
After writing, a new commit, source hash, and exact-source theory/accounting/red-team review are required before any import or execution action.
maximum_runs remains zero and registered seed access remains false.
source_authorization_amendment.transition_rule: Review GO is advisory. Only a later Coordinator decision conforming byte-for-byte to authorization_decision_schema changes pure_core_source_authorized to true.
